name: YouTube
behavior: Native YouTube interface, NewPipe extraction, alternate Innertube clients, Media3 playback.

name: YouTube Web
behavior: Local FreeTube application at file:///android_asset/index.html, Vue and Shaka.

name: YouTube Music
behavior: Music YouTube WebView and authenticated Innertube request support.

name: Web Browser
behavior: General browsing, Google search, bookmarks and browsing history.

name: TV / IPTV
behavior: M3U and Xtream playlists, live/VOD/series, EPG, favorites, playback progress.

name: File Manager
behavior: Local file navigation and document access.

name: Video Player
behavior: Local video playback and playback history.

name: Radio
behavior: Radio Browser and Radio Garden discovery, stream playback, multiple proxy fallbacks.

name: Music
behavior: Local audio playback with lyric lookup through LRCLIB and Kugou.

name: Speedometer
behavior: Location-based speed display; runtime accuracy and units not tested.

name: Screen Mirror
behavior: MediaProjection to a display surface, AccessibilityService gesture forwarding.

name: Podcast
behavior: Podcast discovery and subscriptions, feed parsing, episode progress/download metadata.

name: News
behavior: RSS news feeds and text-to-speech support.

name: Movies & Series
behavior: Stremio-compatible add-on manifests, catalogs, metadata and stream requests; torrent-only items are marked unsupported.

name: Vehicle Maintenance
behavior: Service dates, odometer values, due dates, due mileage and notes.

name: Settings
behavior: Appearance, language, module order, playback and device integration settings.
